fx.rate_source: fx.csv (one rate per calendar day, source_currency -> target_currency)
fx.rate_date: calendar date of the document timestamp (invoice issued_at / payment timestamp) converted to the manifest timezone

period.basis: document timestamp converted to the manifest timezone
period.ledger_scope: the ledger holds only postings for documents dated inside the period; invoices issued before the period were booked in their own period

rounding.unit: minor unit of the target currency

allocation: every payment must be fully allocated: amount_minor == sum(invoice_refs[].amount_minor); refunds are negative payments with negative allocations
duplicates: an invoice duplicates another if entity_id, currency, total_minor and the multiset of line items are identical and issue instants are within 7 days

postings.payment: per allocation Dr 1000 / Cr 1200 (invoice_id = allocated invoice); unallocated remainder Dr 1000 / Cr 2900 (invoice_id null)
postings.currency: all ledger rows are in the base currency

missing_or_partial_allocation.affected_ids: payment_id plus every invoice_id the payment references

wrong_fx_date_or_rate.affected_ids: the invoice_id or payment_id whose ledger rows use a wrong rate
wrong_fx_date_or_rate.amount: sum over the document's debit rows of |booked - correct|, base currency
wrong_fx_date_or_rate.evidence: doc_id, fx key of the correct rate, and all debit rows (or all credit rows) of the document

period_misattribution.affected_ids: invoice_id booked in the wrong period
period_misattribution.evidence: doc_id and one ledger row of that booking
